answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Every claim climbs the raven of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the sonnet re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the mirror of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
